content.comment_body: I would like to add variable memory mapping to my code, but I'm not sure how to use it within the [product_name] web editor.
I believe you are referring to parameter-variable memory mapping. Your question is rather broad, as there are several types of variables and their usage differs depending on context.

The variable memories I'm talking about are the ones I want to use. I need to change the time of the on-delay and reset the timewatch function. I managed to get the timewatch reset to work with an analog output, but I'm unclear on how it functions, as I didn't connect it to anything specific; I just included it in the code.
It seems your parameter-variable mapping is somewhat disorganized, and you are overlapping multiple variables.
Are you sure the variable addresses you are using are correct?

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience challenges understanding how to correctly apply variable memory mapping, especially in the [product_name] web editor. There is confusion regarding handling variable addresses and linking them to functions like time delay adjustments and timewatch resets. Variable overlap and unclear addressing methods within the editor make this process more complicated and lessen user confidence.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily map and control variables within the web editor, directly link variable addresses to logic functions, and be able to use the interface to adjust key parameters such as time delay.
